about: The six scenes of the render-acceleration benchmark (guide section 7.3). Paths are relative to this folder. reference_spp is the job's own samples_per_pixel; adaptive_max_spp is the cap of the adaptive runs. render_args are extra flags the scripts give render / tilt-video for that scene.

scenes.title: High-dispersion stone under spot lights
scenes.description: Pentalume Sapphire geometry rendered in Synthetic Moissanite (the strongest built-in dispersion) under the Dark Spotlight rig: sharp glints and fire.

scenes.title: Dark royal-blue sapphire
scenes.description: Pentalume Sapphire face-up in daylight: deep extinction, the case where dark areas must not stop too early.

scenes.title: Stone small in the frame
scenes.description: The same sapphire at three times the camera distance: the stone covers well under 15 percent of the pixels and the rest is background.

scenes.title: Three consecutive tilt-video frames
scenes.description: Frames 1 to 3 of a tilt video of the Pentalume Sapphire (0, 1 and 2 degrees on axis 0). Each frame is compared on its own; the scene's result is the worst frame.

scenes.title: Scattering material (white opal)
scenes.description: Pentalume Sapphire geometry rendered in the built-in Opal: a scattering body, so the path cache must fall back to the path tracer and the image must match.

scenes.title: 8K still at 32k samples
scenes.description: The Pentalume Sapphire at 7680 x 4320 and 32768 samples per pixel (the largest count a job allows): the high-end case.
